# UI design exploration: [screen or feature]

> Status: Exploring / Prototype ready / Direction accepted / Handed off to spec · Owner: [engineer/designer] · Date: [date] · Repository / branch: [name]

Use this optional template when the engineer wants to explore a screen or interaction before committing to a feature spec. A prototype demonstrates a design direction; it does not define accepted scope until the engineer decides.
